overview: The Great Rann of Kutch is a vast white salt desert that glows under the full moon. During Rann Utsav (Nov–Feb) a tent city comes up at Dhordo, with crafts villages around Bhuj.
fit: Fun for both: camel carts, full-moon walks on the salt, folk music and crafts.
season: November to February only; the Rann is under water in the monsoon. Nights are cold (8–12°C) in December–January.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Bhuj (1-stop) or Ahmedabad then train/flight

gettingAround: Cab from Bhuj; camel carts on the salt.
